method: Median RGB of a manually inspected fabric-only rectangle in the exact verified variant photo. Coordinates are normalized [left, top, right, bottom], rounded to pixels. Multi-color, gradient, packaging, unverified and legacy choices use a neutral pattern instead of an estimated flat color.
